# sigclip_combine_1d { #reducers.sigclip_combine_1d }

```python
sigclip_combine_1d(
    values,
    *,
    mask=None,
    combine,
    sigma=(3.0, 3.0),
    maxiters=5,
    ddof=0,
    nkeep=0,
    maxrej=None,
    cenfunc='median',
    clip_cen=None,
    stdfunc='std',
    revert_on_nkeep=False,
    validate=True,
)
```

Return a 1-D sigma-clipped mean or median.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**values**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [(ndarray, shape(N))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   One sample vector.

<code>[**mask**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Same shape as the input; `True` excludes a sample. Default `None`.

<code>[**sigma**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float or (float, float)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [(3.0, 3.0)]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Finite, nonnegative lower and upper multipliers; default `(3.0, 3.0)`. Samples exactly on a threshold survive.

<code>[**maxiters**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [5]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Maximum attempted passes; default `5`. `0` applies initial exclusions only.

<code>[**ddof**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Divide squared deviations by ``n - ddof``; default `0`. Ignored for MAD. Undefined statistics stop the current pass without changing the mask.

<code>[**nkeep**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rollback minimum, active only with `revert_on_nkeep=True`; default `0`. This is not a final minimum-count requirement.

<code>[**maxrej**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Roll back a pass if total exclusions exceed this count. Counts input masks and nonfinite samples as well as clipping; default `None` (unlimited).

<code>[**cenfunc**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'median\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rejection center: `"median"` (default), `"lmedian"`, or `"mean"`.

<code>[**clip_cen**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Dispersion center: `"mean"`, `"median"`, `"lmedian"`, or `"cenfunc"` to use the computed rejection center directly. `None` follows `cenfunc`'s estimator, preserving its arithmetic; default `None`.

<code>[**stdfunc**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'std\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   `"std"` (default) or `"mad"` (median absolute deviation times 1.4826).

<code>[**revert_on_nkeep**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Enable whole-pass survivor rollback; default `False`. Earlier accepted rejections and initial exclusions remain after rollback.

<code>[**combine**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Required statistic: `"mean"`, `"average"`, `"avg"`, `"median"`, or `"med"`.

<code>[**validate**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Validate/promote arrays; default `True`. With `False`, supply a 1-D float32/float64 vector.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**value**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Clipped mean or median; NaN if none survive.

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

NaN, infinities, and input masks are excluded before clipping.
Inputs are never modified. Accepted rejections accumulate. Empty/all-excluded inputs
have all-excluded masks, NaN extrema/spread, and NaN fused reductions.

With `validate=True`, `float32` and `float64` are preserved; `uint8`, `uint16`,
and `int16` use `float32`, and `int32` uses `float64`. Other dtypes are rejected.
Noncontiguous input is copied only when needed. Centers and MAD round to the
input dtype before threshold comparisons. Squared residuals and limits can
overflow or underflow.
